author: reek
body: The AssetForge diffusion screen, moved out of `apps/guios/DiffusionApp.codex` so it stops citing `GuiDisplay`, `GuiTimer` and `GopRender`. This is the MECHANICAL half of that move and nothing more.

author: reek
body: What did not survive the move, and why: the old chapter painted its preview area, progress bar and a duck-shaped placeholder with `gop-buf-rect` calls straight into a GopBuf. A pane hands back a tree now, so the progress bar is a `WkGauge` -- which the compositor draws, and which carries the same two numbers the hand-drawn bar did -- and the placeholder is a labelled panel. The duck is gone: it was five rectangles of pixel art with no widget kind behind it, and inventing one to keep a placeholder would be the tail wagging the dog.

author: reek
body: The dropdown, validation, settings and palette definitions are unchanged. They are data, they were always portable, and they are the part of this screen that is real.

author: reek
body: The layout is a plain vertical stack for the same reason. The first attempt put the buttons beside the fields and the tab row in a flexible column, and the tabs took a quarter of the screen while the Generate column was squeezed to a few pixels at the right edge. A stack of rows with explicit heights is what the other panes use and what the flex engine does predictably.

author: reek
body: The preview is a panel with a caption. `step` drives a gauge rather than a hand-filled rectangle, and it is the same pair of numbers: progress out of `gdf-steps`. At step 0 the caption says there is no image, which is the honest state of this app.

author: reek
body: Labels and separators take their natural height and ONE child is flexible: the empty canvas panel absorbs the slack. That is the shape `gtk-tree` uses and it lays out predictably. Setting `flex 0` on the panels to pin them was tried in the calculator and collapses them -- flex 0 is no share of the main axis, not size-to-content.
